lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing shadows on the bedroom wall
Watching the city lights begin to fade
The coffee cools in a ceramic cup
Waiting for the morning light to break
[Pre-Chorus]
A quiet hum in the evening air
The weight of words we left to share
[Chorus]
Hold me close in the velvet gray
Where the secrets of the night remain
A steady pulse in the steady glow
Finding the rhythm in the ebb and flow
[Verse]
Raindrops dancing on the window pane
Whispers of memories in the hallway light
The moon hangs low like a silver thread
Tracing the lines of a story told
[Pre-Chorus]
A quiet hum in the evening air
The weight of words we left to share
[Chorus]
Hold me close in the velvet gray
Where the secrets of the night remain
A steady pulse in the steady glow
Finding the rhythm in the ebb and flow
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Lost in the space between the heartbeats
Finding the peace in the moments we keep
[Chorus]
Hold me close in the velvet gray
Where the secrets of the night remain
A steady pulse in the steady glow
Finding the rhythm in the ebb and flow
[Outro]
